newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds tread water ahead of FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds tread water ahead of FOMC meeting.

text.p: 1605 GMT - Austrian bonds close lower in slow trade on Monday as investors in wait-and-see mood ahead of Tuesday's U.S. FOMC meeting, traders said. Market seen moving sideways over next few days amid lack of strong international leads.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 down 20 bps at 98.30 to yield 5.85 pct (5.82) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.40/50 to yield 5.84/82.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed down five bps at 97.95 in bourse trade to yield 4.85 pct (4.84), quoted post-market at 97.95/98.03 to yield 4.85/4.83 percent.
* AGB future down four bps at 107.30 on turnover of 404 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at minus six bps, five-year spread up eight at 13 bps.
* Money market rates higher with three-month VIBOR at 3.372 and overnight money at 3.12/3.37.
